finding: THE SECOND GEOMETRY SYSTEM — 26 geometry-kernel producers + 19 plugin committers + scene-committer host. AUTHORED and COMPOSABLE. NOT REACHABLE in the shipped app.
head: d91d30d4af51bc67317ef8afc0b46b1dbef94038
why_it_matters_for_AXIS_B: This is the single largest rival-builder finding of the phase, and it explains most of the FIDELITY gaps below. The L0 element schemas were written FOR this system. The system that actually draws is the legacy fragment-builder half, whose records are narrower. So a field can be 'authored, validated, persisted and consumed' and still never reach a pixel — because the consumer is on the unreachable side.

ladder.AUTHORED: YES — 26 producers under packages/geometry-kernel/src/producers/ (beam, boolean, ceiling, column, curtainwall, dimension, door, extrude, furniture, grid, handrail, lighting, loft, plumbing, revolve, roof, room, section-cut, slab, stair, structural, sweep, wall, wallVoids, window) plus per-family geometry hashes under _internal/. 19 per-family committers under plugins/*/src/committer/*-committer.ts (beam, ceiling, column, curtain-wall, dimensions, door, furniture, grid, handrail, lighting, plumbing, roof, rooms, slab, stair, structural, wall, window, plan-view/annotation).
ladder.COMPOSABLE: YES — apps/editor/src/bootstrap.render.everything.ts:135-158 constructs FOUR of the nineteen (WallCommitter, SlabCommitter, DoorCommitter, WindowCommitter) and registers them on the CommitterHost. The file states its own scope at :14-15: 'the registry-side PluginDescriptor has no buildCommitter hook — that's a separate piece of work — so the four committers are [wired here]'.

proof_chain: bootstrapRenderEverything is invoked ONLY from packages/renderer/src/SceneBootstrap.ts:184-185 (`const bootstrapRenderEverything = await input.loadRenderEverything(); const result = await bootstrapRenderEverything({...})`).
loadRenderEverything is supplied ONLY by packages/runtime-composer/src/composeRuntime.ts:1490, inside the closure that calls bootstrapScene(canvas, ...).
bootstrapScene REQUIRES a canvas — packages/renderer/src/SceneBootstrap.ts:61 `readonly canvas: HTMLCanvasElement` (non-optional).

The production boot passes NO canvas — src/main.ts:421 `canvas: null`, with the comment at :419 'No canvas in the white-UI boot path — scene.renderer slot stays [null]'. composeRuntime therefore takes the IDLE arm, `bootstrapSceneIdle(inner.host)` (composeRuntime.ts:1469 / SceneBootstrap.ts:228), which returns `{ renderer: null, scheduler: null, host, materialPool: null }` and never touches bootstrapRenderEverything.

The documented escape hatch `runtime.scene.mount(canvas, mode?)` has ZERO production call sites. `grep -rnE '^[^/*]*\.mount\(' --include=*.ts src apps packages plugins | grep -v node_modules | grep -v __tests__` returns workspace.surface.mount, globe.mount, rendererBackendToggle.mount, panel .mount — no scene mount. apps/editor/src/ui/platform/PlatformShell.ts:86-93 only console.debug's that the slot exists; its comment says 'Phase D.4 replaces the legacy window.world refs with runtime.scene.mount(canvas)' — future tense.

produceDoor / produceWindow / produceLighting / produceRoom / produceStructural have ZERO production call sites: `grep -rn 'produceDoor|produceWindow|produceLighting|produceRoom|produceStructural' --include=*.ts apps packages plugins | grep -v node_modules | grep -v __tests__ | grep -v geometry-kernel/src` → apps/bench benches, the @pryzm/plugin-sdk barrel re-export (:294, :296), and two COMMENTS.

The exception that proves the rule: produceWallWithVoids IS reachable — but only through apps/editor/src/engine/singleVolumeWallProducer.ts, injected into the LEGACY WallFragmentBuilder as a strategy (initTools.ts:930) and default-off behind window.__wallSingleVolume. The kernel is used as a maths library by the legacy builder, not as the geometry pipeline it was designed to be.

the_repo_already_measured_this_once.quote: 'DoorCommitter is constructed only at bootstrap.render.everything.ts:140, reached only via SceneBootstrap.bootstrapScene, which requires a canvas (SceneBootstrap.ts:61). src/main.ts:402 boots with canvas: null — the "idle" path (SceneBootstrap.ts:226). So the committer is never constructed and this dispatch reaches no mesh.'

consequence_for_fidelity: Several L0 fields whose only reader is on the unreachable side are AUTHORED-AND-CONSUMED-BUT-NEVER-DRAWN: Door.frameMaterialId / Door.leafMaterialId (only readers: packages/geometry-kernel/src/producers/door.ts + LiftAssembly), Window.glassMaterialId / Window.frameMaterialId (only reader: producers/window.ts + LiftAssembly), Lighting.dropLength (only readers: producers/lighting.ts, composeLightingGeometryHash.ts, plugins/lighting/src/committer/lighting-committer.ts), Plumbing.systemTag / Plumbing.bendRadius (only readers: producers/plumbing.ts + its hash), Structural.endOffset (producers/structural.ts + its hash), Dimension.overrideText (producers/dimension.ts + its hash), Room.seedPoint (producers/room.ts + its hash). Each looks 'wired' to a field-name grep and draws nothing.
honesty_verdict: PARTIALLY HONEST. bootstrap.render.everything.ts declares its four-of-nineteen scope in its own header. SceneBootstrap declares the idle path. But nothing in packages/geometry-kernel/src/producers/ or plugins/*/committer/ says 'this file is not on the shipped render path', and PropertyInspectorApply.ts had to record the discovery as a correction to a comment that asserted the opposite.
NOT_A_RECOMMENDATION: This phase does not propose the fix. Note only that 'wire the committers' and 'widen the CEB emit' are RIVAL fixes for the same symptoms, and doing both would create a third rival.
